title: AXI4 Read and Write Transaction Lifetimes
description: Compare the independent channel windows that make a write or read outstanding; each colored phase can stall or overlap unrelated channel activity.

phases.name: Address accepted
phases.description: The AW handshake accepts the write address and attributes. W data can appear before, with, or after this edge.

phases.name: W beats
phases.description: One or more W handshakes transfer write data in write-address order; WLAST marks the final beat.

phases.name: B response
phases.description: After the accepted AW and final W beat, the B handshake completes the write at the master interface.

phases.name: Address accepted
phases.description: The AR handshake accepts the read address and attributes and creates an outstanding read.

phases.name: R beats + response
phases.description: Each R handshake transfers data with RID and RRESP. The beat with RLAST completes the read.

labels: Data and response channels retire it

annotations.message: AW and W are independent: a W beat can reach an interface before the corresponding AW request.
AXI4 BVALID depends on acceptance of both the AW request and the final W beat.
The read response travels with every R beat; there is no separate read-response channel.
